title: Pieter Levels: AI now lets him build faster than he gets new ideas
summary: A one-line post from Pieter Levels observing that with AI-assisted coding, building speed now outpaces idea generation. It signals a shift in the bottleneck for solo makers from execution to ideation.

principles.text: With AI-assisted building, the bottleneck for makers shifts from execution to coming up with ideas.
principles.quote: It's such a weird experience that I can now build things faster than I get new ideas for things
